line.en: Wood type slid into a composing line and pressed into cream cotton stock, in deep ink and one vermilion, for headlines and big figures.
line.zh-CN: 木活字逐个排进字盘，再压进奶油色棉纸：深墨加一点朱红，用来做标题和大数字。

for.en: Short films that turn on a few statements and figures: history and culture explainers, anniversaries, reports and promos that want a crafted, tactile voice.
for.zh-CN: 靠几句话和几个数字撑起的短片：历史与文化讲解、周年纪念、报告与需要手作质感的宣传。

not.en: Diagrams, maps or anything that needs a picture: it prints only type and ornaments. Fast, loud promos.
not.zh-CN: 示意图、地图或任何需要画面的内容：它只印字和花饰。节奏很快、很吵的宣传片。
